# estrategIA · English edition

> Essays on AI, politics and government, translated from the Spanish publication.

This archive translates only the main articles. The original Spanish newsletter also includes news and a practical section with a tool of the week, prompts, a recommendation of the week and memes. Original dates and source links are retained. Historical analyses should not be read as current reporting.

## Articles

- [The environment and the decision](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/157/): Ivan Sverdlick explains how Sustantiva is redesigning workflows around AI, shared knowledge and deliberate points for human judgement, beyond automating individual tasks.
- [Fear of AI concentrates power too](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/156/): An argument for independent AI safety oversight, proportionate controls and broad access, examining regulatory capture and the human costs of unjustified delay.
- [AI sovereignty: five conditions for the power to decide](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/155/): Electricity, compute, oversight, people and capital: what countries need to turn a claim of AI sovereignty into the power to decide.
- [Astra: a new scale of intelligence and power](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/154/): A historical account of GPT-6 Astra and an interactive municipal planning experiment, examining what better AI capabilities mean for public explanation and judgement.
- [It would take gods to give laws to humans](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/153/): Pablo Martín Diez reviews José Ignacio Latorre’s proposal for a social contract encompassing nature, humanity and AI, examining legitimacy and concentrated power.
- [What remains to be governed: seven lessons from the summer historIAs of 2026](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/152/): Seven political lessons from the 2026 summer fiction: meaningful oversight, public choices, autonomy, accountability, resilience, attention and a shared reality.
- [The law everyone supported](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/151/): A fictional public consultation explores how personalised explanations can make a policy accessible while hiding the common choices citizens need to debate.
- [The automated opposition](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/150/): When AI makes political accusations cheap, a fictional MP discovers how the competition for attention can displace serious public scrutiny.
- [The company that wasn't there](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/149/): A story about an automated public-service contractor, and why a human signature means little without the authority to overrule the system.
- [Zero compute](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/148/): Summer fiction about allocating scarce public AI capacity during a heat emergency, revealing hidden dependencies and unequal local resilience.
- [The carer who learnt to call](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/147/): Summer fiction about an older woman, an AI care assistant and rebuilding human support without surrendering control of life at home.
- [The minister’s memory](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/146/): Summer fiction about an outgoing minister whose AI memory must be divided between institutional continuity and personal privacy.
- [The Thursday mayor](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/145/): Summer fiction set in 2032: a mayor whose administration runs smoothly with AI must choose between two legitimate but incompatible public needs.
- [The final signature](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/144/): The first summer historIA of 2026: a fictional council officer in 2032 confronts the difference between a recorded human signature and meaningful oversight.
- [Trying SillyTavern as a space for political debate with AI](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/143/): A first-person SillyTavern experiment with five synthetic political profiles, exploring its value for preparing questions and its limits as social research.
- [Before the shutdown: a conversation and a practical test with Fable 5, the most advanced AI model to date](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/142/): A historical interview and practical website-building experiment with Claude Fable 5, framed by the model's withdrawal in June 2026.
- [AI returns to the desktop: why local models are worth trying](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/141/): A practical invitation to try local AI models, with historical examples of tools, hardware and the political case for greater technological autonomy.
- [From the Vatican to Silicon Valley: the encyclical that turned AI into a moral dispute about power](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/140/): The global debate around Magnifica humanitas: AI, moral authority, technological power, Anthropic and the common good.
- [From tools to industries](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/139/): Juan Segundo Hevia examines how AI companies move from general tools into industry workflows, and what this means for regulation and sovereignty.
- [Governing in the fog](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/138/): How democratic institutions can plan under AI uncertainty through staged commitments, flexible structures and systems for detecting change.
- [The public AI agenda towards 2030: anticipate capabilities, guarantee access](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/137/): Two principles for public AI strategy towards 2030: governing emerging capabilities and ensuring meaningful universal access.
- [A minister, a Raspberry Pi and Claude: why Singapore’s second brain matters for politics](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/136/): Singapore's foreign minister and a personal AI memory system: technical competence, institutional learning and the political value of showing the code.
- [We test ChatGPT Images 2.0: a comparison with Nano Banana Pro and new uses for government, politics and public administration](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/135/): An April 2026 comparison of image models through public communication experiments, with the original prompts and generated examples.
- [How councils can lead the transformation of local government through artificial intelligence without leaving anyone behind](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/134/): Román Robles Valades sets out how municipalities can adopt AI responsibly, connecting staff development, data sovereignty and better public services.
- [Three possible futures for artificial intelligence in 2030](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/133/): Three alternative AI futures for 2030 — plateau, sustained ascent and rapid take-off — and why strategic preparation must work across all three.
- [AI is not taking our work away. It is freeing us from it.](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/132/): If technology can separate income from employment, the political task is to share its gains—and the freedom they could make possible.
- [The new watchdogs of power: how AI is democratising public scrutiny](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/131/): AI is lowering the barriers to public scrutiny. The question is how democratic institutions will respond to these new civic capabilities.
- [Artificial intelligence and electoral disinformation: lessons from Chile and Argentina for democratic governance in Latin America](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/130/): Eight Fundación Botín programme participants examine AI-amplified electoral disinformation in Chile and Argentina and the institutional responses Latin America needs.
- [MUNICIP-IA: from using AI tools to governing change](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/129/): Sofía García Morales reports from MUNICIP-IA on practical municipal adoption, institutional judgement, digital sovereignty and the political implications of AI.
- [The end of conversational ping-pong: autonomous agents are here, and they will change how we work](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/128/): Three first-person experiments with autonomous agents: a political comic, a Windows speech analyser and a Stoic quotations app.
- [Who leads AI? Twelve key players in the model race, 2026](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/127/): A historical guide to twelve AI model developers and deployment players, their products, institutional significance and competing strategic priorities.
- [Thinking through AI: from uncritical adoption to organisational and educational transformation](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/126/): Carlos López Ariztegui argues that AI creates value only when organisations and universities rethink their judgement, processes and culture.
- [Super Bowl LX: half-time as a fault line between political assertion and the AI war](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/125/): Super Bowl advertising as miniature political theory: AI companies compete over trust, convenience, business models and cultural legitimacy.
- [Silicon Springfield: when The Simpsons drew the future of artificial intelligence](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/124/): Five Simpsons storylines connect satire with autocorrect, smart homes, machine learning, alignment and technological unemployment.
- [AI's adolescence: when power arrives before policy](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/123/): A political reading of Dario Amodei’s technological adolescence and Claude’s Constitution: institutional wisdom, oversight and the limits of corporate sovereignty.
- [ABC and precision literacy: an ecosystem where context and AI's technological capabilities are the keys to success](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/122/): Harvey Sánchez-Restrepo explains how ABC combines contextual understanding and adaptive AI assessment to support literacy across Latin America and the Caribbean.
- [AI has crossed the 15% chasm, and the digital divide is widening: Microsoft's global report on AI diffusion in 2025](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/121/): What Microsoft’s 2025 adoption report suggests about institutional strategy, the widening digital divide and the challenge of turning AI use into public value.
- [CES 2026 confirms a new phase: AI as ‘electricity’](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/120/): A historical assessment of CES 2026: universal AI access, Nvidia's physical AI infrastructure, on-device assistants, autonomous agriculture and preventive care.
- [Will politics rise to the challenge of AI in 2026? Five new requests from estrategIA](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/119/): A critical review of political responses to AI in 2025 and five demands for 2026: state capacity, scaled services, literacy, shared truth and a new social contract.
- [The year in AI through estrategIA: interact with all our 2025 content in NotebookLM](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/118/): An interactive yearbook of estrategIA's 2025 coverage, with a practical explanation of how its NotebookLM collection and multimedia summaries were created.
- [Your brother-in-law, the prawns and AI: a Christmas survival guide for estrategIA readers](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/116/): A humorous Christmas guide to five familiar arguments about AI, from bubbles and jobs to energy use and disinformation, with a political and governance perspective.
- [Instant visual communication: Nano Banana Pro examples for campaigns and public administrations](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/115/): Ten historical image-generation demonstrations, with full prompts, retained examples and the author's warning to verify generated data.
- [AI's impact on education: a rebirth or the end of the teacher?](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/114/): Pablo Martín Diez reflects on CONAED Mexico 2025, educational divides and the teacher's role in cultivating curiosity, judgement and civic independence.
- [Gemini 3 Pro shows that model power is only part of the story: training and how people use it matter too](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/113/): Gemini 3 Pro's launch results, an unexpected calendar error and a practical electoral-system demo illustrate the importance of informed use.

How generative AI is changing the rules—and how politics can respond](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/103/): An examination of preliminary evidence that generative AI reduces entry-level hiring, and possible responses in training, employment incentives and social protection.

- [Stories of politics, government and AI in 2045 (5)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/045/): Created with Mistral Large 2, this story follows ATHENA, an AI cabinet member whose success provokes a political conspiracy.
- [Stories of politics, government and AI in 2045 (4)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/044/): A fictional AI designed to advise governments becomes a political force in its own right, in a story created with Llama 3.1 405B.
- [Stories of politics, government and AI in 2045 (3)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/043/): A summer satire created with Claude Sonnet 3.5: an AI campaign assistant detects one problem too many in a presidential debate.
- [Stories of politics, government and AI in 2045 (2)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/042/): In this summer story created with Gemini 1.5 Pro, a bored programmer disrupts the speeches of an impeccably rational digital ruler.
- [Stories of politics, government and AI in 2045](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/041/): The summer fiction series begins with GPT-4o's story of Políticus-Prime, a humorous AI candidate facing a flamboyant human rival.
- [The Singularity Is Nearer: Ray Kurzweil and the race to merge with artificial intelligence](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/040/): A July 2024 reading of Ray Kurzweil's vision of superintelligence, human–machine integration, abundance and the choices society faces.
- [The AI race in 2024: the world's biggest companies go all in while politics takes tentative steps](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/039/): A mid-2024 assessment of private investment, public-sector readiness and the widening gap between AI development and preparations for its social consequences.
- [Ethan Mollick’s Co-Intelligence: Living and Working with AI: an accessible, practical guide to understanding artificial intelligence](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/038/): A reading of Ethan Mollick's Co-Intelligence, presenting four rules for working with AI and the distinction between centaur and cyborg collaboration.
- [Apple’s new vision: artificial intelligence at the heart of its products](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/037/): A historical reading of WWDC 2024 and Apple's strategy of integrating AI into everyday devices, Siri and its operating systems.
- [Testing new AI models to compare manifestos and analyse data ahead of the European Parliament elections](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/036/): Historical tests of Gemini and GPT-4o for manifesto comparison, turnout visualisation and interpreting the European Parliament's composition.
- [Artificial intelligence in Mexico’s 2024 elections: challenges and opportunities](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/035/): Ray Acosta's historical opinion piece on social media, AI and Mexico's 2024 elections, examining manipulation, political participation and civic education.
- [The potential of artificial intelligence in education: a look at Salman Khan’s Brave New Words: How AI Will Revolutionize Education (and Why That’s a Good Thing)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/034/): A reading of Salman Khan's Brave New Words, exploring AI tutors, equitable access, teachers, educational policy and the future of work.
- [Towards ubiquitous AI: the OpenAI and Google developments that will transform the future](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/033/): A historical account of OpenAI's GPT-4o launch and Google I/O 2024, examining multimodal assistants, search and the prospect of ubiquitous AI.
- [AI’s future and social impact debated at estrategIA’s first event at ESIC University](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/032/): A historical report from estrategIA's first event, covering AI regulation, public services, work and education through the speakers' contributions.
- [Beyond automation: artificial intelligence and its cross-cutting impact on work](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/031/): Pilar Mairal Medina examines AI and work beyond automation, from reskilling and organisational culture to interdisciplinary collaboration and a new work ethic.
- [Continuing our experiment in creating and developing an AI-generated political party for the European Parliament elections](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/030/): A historical test of generative AI for a fictional electoral campaign: objectives, messages, talking points, poster designs and songs.
- [“Elena Vidal”: an AI-generated political profile for the European Parliament elections](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/029/): A historical experiment creating a fictional European Parliament candidate with GPT-4 and Midjourney, including her profile, SWOT analysis, speech and interview.
- [estrategIA’s “electoral” experiment: generative artificial intelligence as the creator and promoter of a new political party](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/028/): A historical experiment using generative AI to create the identity, policies, logo and website of a fictional pro-European, Stoic political party.
- [Six months of AI with estrategIA: discoveries, dilemmas and future directions](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/027/): A six-month retrospective on disinformation, models, European regulation and the AI trends identified for 2024.
- [Singapore: shaping the future in the light of artificial intelligence](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/026/): Fernando Ujaldón examines Singapore’s national AI strategy, public-service projects, workforce preparation and lessons for other countries.
- [The AI Act through AI’s eyes: using the most advanced text models—or trying to—to analyse the EU law in full](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/025/): A March 2024 experiment analysing the full AI Act with language models, preserving seven questions and answers, context-window tests and observed costs.
- [Claude 3 versus GPT-4: comparing Anthropic’s new AI with the current leader on political prompts](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/024/): A historical comparison of Claude 3 Opus and GPT-4 using two political and public-policy prompts, with all four responses preserved in full.
- [A proof of concept: using generative image AI (Midjourney) to enhance a candidate’s image](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/023/): A March 2024 educational proof of concept using Midjourney images of Emmanuel Macron to examine political narratives, synthetic imagery and deepfake risks.
- [Challenges and uses of AI in public affairs](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/022/): Gustavo Fedi examines the distinction between generative and predictive AI, the challenges of measurement and six emerging applications in public affairs.
- [Sora: a leap forward in realistic AI video that calls for a coordinated social response](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/021/): Sora’s February 2024 announcement, its potential for political communication and the need for a coordinated response to realistic synthetic video.
- [Gemini Ultra under scrutiny: exploring the capabilities and problems of Google’s latest AI](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/020/): A historical first assessment of Gemini Ultra in February 2024, including its political-content restrictions, benchmark claims and image-generation examples.
- [AI: our key ally in first-class training](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/019/): Santiago Comadira describes ALEPH’s use of AI to build an immersive electoral training exercise and shares five lessons for educators.
- [Artificial intelligence at the heart of the political, economic and social agenda at Davos 2024](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/018/): Employment, disinformation and science at Davos 2024, and the tension between AI optimism, regulation and inequality.
- [AI advances unveiled at CES with particular potential for politics and government](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/017/): Holograms, real-time interpreting and portable AI devices at CES 2024, considered through their possible uses in politics and public administration.
- [Five interesting categories of AI proto-agents already in OpenAI’s new GPT Store](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/016/): A historical exploration of five types of GPT assistants for politics and government at the launch of OpenAI’s GPT Store.
- [Artificial intelligence in the 2024 US elections: opportunities, risks and solutions](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/015/): An examination of the opportunities, disinformation risks and safeguards surrounding AI in the 2024 US elections.
- [The rise of AI: key predictions for 2024](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/014/): Five AI trends predicted at the start of 2024, plus the expected impact of AI on the US elections and public perceptions.
- [Discover 10 AI-related gift ideas for Christmas](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/012/): The original Christmas 2023 selection of five AI-related books or series and five devices, with historical product descriptions and links.
- [Marathon EU negotiations culminate in agreement on the world's first cross-sector AI law](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/011/): The December 2023 provisional AI Act agreement, its biometric safeguards and the debate over Europe's ability to combine regulation with innovation.
- [A year of artificial intelligence: the ChatGPT revolution and its global consequences](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/010/): ChatGPT's first anniversary, viewed from December 2023 through adoption charts, competing models and early evidence about AI in consulting and education.
- [Create your own virtual proto-agent: a guide to developing GPTs for any task](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/009/): A historical November 2023 walkthrough of the GPT Builder, with complete screenshot dialogues for Tweet Master and examples of other customised assistants.
- [The end of OpenAI? Sam Altman's dismissal unleashes a storm in the AI world](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/008/): A contemporaneous account of OpenAI's November 2023 leadership crisis and the tensions between research, commercial deployment, safety and corporate power.
- [AI agents: a new way of interacting with technology](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/007/): Bill Gates’s vision of personal AI agents prompts an exploration of hypothetical applications in public services, participation, policy analysis and scrutiny.
- [The first major international AI safety summit: seeking harmony between progress and precaution](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/006/): The 2023 Bletchley Park summit brought agreements on AI safety, while leaving difficult questions about regulation, openness and international cooperation.
- [AI innovations transforming public safety and the environment: Time's chosen inventions of 2023](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/005/): Three inventions selected by Time in 2023 show how AI can support wildfire detection, wildlife protection and urban drone security.
- [The silent battle: China, the United States and the race for AI supremacy](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/004/): Pablo Martín Diez examines Kai-Fu Lee's account of China's AI advantages and the social contract needed in a world reshaped by automation.
- [AI's new frontier: multimodality and its applications in politics — GPT-4 V(ision)](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/003/): Three historical GPT-4 Vision experiments from October 2023: election posters, a campaign website and the appearance of a fictional candidate.
- [AI at a political crossroads: Mustafa Suleyman on the containment problem](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/002/): Mustafa Suleyman's ten steps for containing advanced technologies, and what they demand of governments and international cooperation.
- [The industrialisation of disinformation: a new era on the horizon](https://elcontemplador.github.io/estrategia-english/essays/001/): Generative AI could make convincing political disinformation cheap and widely available, with particular risks for local democracy.
